name: Korg microKORG
description: Korg microKORG (2002), its panel knobs on their factory control changes and its NRPNs, in synth and vocoder programs.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/korg/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/korg/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is a control change the document says the instrument recognises, or a row of its NRPN table, with its printed name. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.
Not a parameter here, Data Entry, part of the NRPN messages: CC 6.
Not a parameter here, an NRPN or RPN selector, part of the NRPN messages: CC 98, 99.
Not a parameter here, a channel mode message: CC 120, 121, 123, 124, 125, 126, 127.

41 panel knobs and switches on the control changes the Owner's Manual (p. 56) gives them from the factory; the MIDI Implementation calls them assignable (GLOBAL's Knob & Switch Ctrl Change No. Map), so an instrument set otherwise needs its own. Names and sections are the MIDI Implementation's, each knob found there by its name; values, and what each sends, the Owner's Manual's.

CC 18, 19, 83, 74, 85, 10 mean one thing in a synth program and another in a vocoder program; each is two parameters, the second in the Vocoder group, and is not attributed to either when the instrument sends it.

The two documents name some knobs differently; the MIDI Implementation's names are used: CC 79 is "Filter EG Int" in the Owner's Manual, "EG1 Int" in the MIDI Implementation; CC 90 is "Sync Ctrl" in the Owner's Manual, "Sync Control" in the MIDI Implementation.

parameters.name: OSC 2 Semitone
parameters.description: -24 ~ +24 in the uneven steps *2-5 lists: 0 is -24, 64 is 0, 127 is +24 (and the Owner's Manual, p. 57). In a vocoder program this controller is Vocoder HPF Level instead.

parameters.name: Vocoder HPF Level
parameters.description: In a synth program this controller is OSC 2 Semitone instead.

parameters.name: OSC 2 Tune
parameters.description: 1~127 = -63 ~ 0 ~ +63; 0 is -63 too. In a vocoder program this controller is Vocoder Threshold instead.

parameters.description: In a synth program this controller is OSC 2 Tune instead.
